# BugsBunnylitAP
AP world distribution for Bugs Bunny Lost in Time


how to use:

1. install the bugsbunnylit.apworld
2. download or generate the yaml
3. if you're using Bizhawk 2.7 or 2.8, got to Config > Customize. On the Advanced tab, switch the Lua Core from NLua+KopiLua to Lua+LuaInterface, then restart EmuHawk. (if you're using Bizhawk 2.9 or higher, you can skip this step.)
4. run Bizhawk Client on AP Launcher
5. run Bizhawk, open the game and open bizhawk_generic.lua
6. the handler will be recognized in the main menu
7. enjoy


TROUBLESHOOTING

left a level and merlin hasn't appeared?

just wait and he should, not doing so can cause issue so make sure you talk to merlin after leaving a level

checks not sending through?

save the game, and close/reopen the client, that's a desync issue, it will fix upon reconnecting

notes.text:
big update from a backend perspective, the world is far more sturdy now, and has an AP controlled system for opening and controlling level entrances.
With this version more content will be implemented in the upcoming releases.

New:

- shuffled entry requirements
vanilla: levels open in the vanilla order
shuffled: swaps the requirements for each level, changing the order of unlocks.

- hubs are all open after Nowhere
this is less of a feature and hopefully a temporary solution, in the future having hub unlocks be items would be preferable


Bug Fixes:

- Levels now open when in hub with the appropriate amount of Clocks/GC's
- magic locations are decoupled from their items, you get both separately
- demo or soft resets no longer release checks


Still Existing Bugs:

- tracking for levels like whats cookin doc which have more than 1 magic requirement is still a bit scuffed, the magic wont be behind those areas, however the tracker might think you have access if you have one of the magics (since were still using counters. Once next update comes out this won't be an issue)

- music stops in two instances, objects in the mirror on the turn after the fire hydrants, and the timer slide in carrot-henge. honestly not sure why this occurs yet.

- Bugs Bunny himself

Future content:

- the next update will set each location as a unique location, not a counter 
(wanted this from the beginning but only now found address for this)

- AP enforced level progression
( what this means is if a location is checked the AP will enforce that onto the game, so in case of a crash of save state the game's level values should be correct (currently can't do this due to clocks n carrots using counters))

- adjustable random requirements for levels
(this will make GC's wayy more rewarding)

- adjustable goal requirements
(will also implement GC's into goal requirement as a yaml option)

- potentially new locations/items in the form of ACME crates and challenge timers

- potentially traps in the form of the robots ice trap
